envelope.description: Make the integrity check read the last revision-bearing entry

body.title: Make the integrity check read the last revision-bearing entry
body.summary: Change checkIntegrity in src/workflow/artifact-core/lifecycle.ts so it compares the head against the last change log entry that carries a revision, not against a revision-less entry such as a build round or a feedback post receipt, and keep its callers working.
acceptanceChecks: A receipt or a build round appended after the last content entry does not make a head that is ahead of or different from that entry pass the check
A head that matches its last revision-bearing entry still passes, with or without later revision-less entries
The existing integrity tests still pass

tests.name: integrity-receipts.test.ts: a revision-less receipt or build round after the last content entry does not make a head that differs from that entry pass the integrity check
